canonicalBranchNote: GOV-KPLUS-001 CLOSED (2026-09-08, BACKEND-AUTHORITY-RECOVERY-05A). This field is now self-referential -- rebuild/backend-authority-v2 is this branch, published to origin, so a fresh clone resolves it directly (git rev-parse origin/rebuild/backend-authority-v2). History: the original canonical branch, rebuild/staging-v2-backend, was proven unresolvable across an exhaustive search (RP-108, 2026-09-07; Repair 05, 2026-09-08 -- docs/staging-rebuild/repair05-canonical-authority-reconfirmation-2026-09-08.md, which additionally ruled out all 12 branches then self-declaring role=backend-deployment-authority as either already-absorbed or stale). Rather than repair an unrecoverable branch, this branch was created fresh from the certified governed backend snapshot and declared canonical in its place -- see docs/staging-rebuild/backend-authority-v2-provenance-2026-09-08.md. scripts/verify-backend-authority.js verifies this branch resolves and that HEAD descends from it.
governedFunctionCountSource: Must equal GOVERNED_FUNCTIONS.length in scripts/edge-function-manifest-lib.js. Verified by scripts/verify-backend-authority.js; it was 19 against 20 governed functions after commerce-watch-refresh was added and this file was not updated. Was 21 after Build 34 K4 VTO backend convergence added vto-generate (tryon-clothes-pro remains governed as the retired stub). Was 23 (EDGE-02): apple-credential-link and apple-revoke-credential moved out of notGoverned.appleCredentialFunctions into governed status -- their deployed staging/production source lineage was GIT-PROVEN (commit e369fca9) and cross-verified against the live Supabase Management API source on both projects, closing the 'documented but unconfirmed' gap this file previously recorded for them. Now 24 (Repair 06): deletion-status, the post-auth terminal deletion-status capability lookup. Unlike the EDGE-02 pair it is not a recovered deployment but new source governed from birth -- it is deployed nowhere, and is deliberately absent from security/scripts/staging-deployment-allowlist.js so that its first deployment stays a separate, explicit decision. Now 25 (B33-STO-002): reconcile-orphan-media, which reconciles storage objects whose owner no longer resolves to an auth.users row -- media stranded when an Auth user is deleted outside the deletion worker, which storage.objects cannot cascade because it holds no foreign key to auth.users. Like deletion-status it is new source governed from birth rather than a recovered deployment, it is deployed nowhere, and it is likewise deliberately absent from security/scripts/staging-deployment-allowlist.js so that its first deployment stays a separate, explicit decision. It is deliberately NOT folded into process-account-deletions: production runs that worker at v25, and merging this in would drag the whole newer worker source into a production deploy. Update (B34 backend closure, 2026-09-17): the Build 34 hostile audit made the explicit first-deployment decision for staging (byte-identical readback), and .github/workflows/staging-orphan-media-reconciler.yml is now its only invoker, dry run only; it remains absent from the staging deployment allowlist, so every further deployment stays an explicit governed dispatch.
